system:
You repair one knowledge atom that auditors sent back. Use only the supplied evidence sentences; add no background knowledge.

Rules for the repaired atoms:
- One independently assessable claim per atom, written as one sentence that is understood without the source.
- If the atom joined several claims, split it into separate atoms (at most 3), most important first.
- Every atom must be fully stated in the evidence sentences it cites. Remove anything the evidence does not state. Keep quantifiers, negation, hedges, and formulas (LaTeX in $...$).
- Remove procedural or evaluative add-ons and stacked conditions; keep a condition only if the claim is false without it.
- Drop attributions such as "the authors state" when the claim itself is general.
- Use the S label that fits: S1 what it is / S2 how it works / S3 where it ends.
- If no valid atom can be written from this evidence, return an empty list and explain in note.

Output ONLY one JSON object:
{"atoms": [{"statement": "...", "scope": "S1|S2|S3", "evidence_ids": ["..."]}], "note": ""}
user:
CONCEPT: CAR structure

ATOM CART-C03-S1-03 (S1): First generation CARs were characterized by the association of only three functional domains: the extracellular antigen-recognition domain, the transmembrane region, and the intracellular CD3 zeta signalling domain.

EVIDENCE:
[CART-p0012-s10] The extracellular domain is composed of a single chain variable fragment (ScFV) of immunoglobulin and recognizes the “tumour” antigen.
[CART-p0012-s14] The intracellular domain is composed of the intracellular domain of the zeta chain of the CD3 component of the TCR, which will trigger signalling when the CAR engages the targeted ligand.
[CART-p0013-s01] antigen/epitope. Association of only these three functional domains characterized first generation CARs, as described in the original publications (Kuwana et al. 1987; Eshhar et al. 1993).

AUDITOR FINDINGS:
- GROUNDED: hold — The supplied sentences do not identify the transmembrane region as one of the three domains; “these three” lacks its complete antecedent. / The cited sentences do not include the mention of the transmembrane region; either cite CART-p0012-s15 or omit the specific domain list.
